observations: Three photos show a hairdryer and hairstreamer set on a tiled floor.
The device has a large, rounded, blue and grey plastic head with a visible blue interior.
It includes a stand with two adjustable arms, each with a black nozzle or attachment.
A power cord is visible, extending from the base to a plug.
The stand appears to be made of grey plastic with a camouflage-like pattern on one arm.
No brand or model name is visible on any part of the device in any photo.
The photos are watermarked with 'AYOMAYOWA OLANIKEKUN' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: All three photos show a hairdryer and hairstreamer set, consistent with the seller's description.

risks.risk: The device may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the device powered on, with the fan running and steam output, or a close-up of the power cord and plug to check for damage.

risks.risk: The stand or attachments may be loose, broken, or missing parts.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the stand joints and attachments, showing they are securely attached and intact.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or incomplete

risks.risk: The power cord may be damaged or frayed, posing a safety hazard.
risks.proof: A close-up of the entire power cord, including the plug, to check for cuts, fraying, or exposed wires.

proof_requests: A video showing the device in operation, including the fan and steam output.
Close-up photos of the power cord and plug to check for damage.
Close-up photos of the stand joints and attachments to confirm they are intact and secure.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
